function.name: read_file
function.description: Read a file from disk. Returns file content with line numbers.

function.name: list_dir
function.description: List directory contents. Returns array of {name, type} entries.

function.name: search
function.description: Search for a pattern in files using grep. Returns matching lines.

path.description: Directory or file to search in (default: current dir)

function.name: write_file
function.description: Write content to a file. Creates parent directories if needed.

content.description: Content to write to the file

function.name: apply_patch
function.description: Apply a git-format patch to modify files. Prefer this over rewriting entire files.

patch.description: Patch content in git diff format

function.name: run
function.description: Run a shell command. Use for npm, git, and other CLI tools.

function.name: done
function.description: Signal that the spec is complete. Call this when all requirements are met.

summary.description: Brief summary of what was accomplished

function.name: app_start
function.description: Start the dev server and open a browser. MUST call this before any other app_* tools.

function.name: app_stop
function.description: Stop the dev server and close the browser. Call this when done with UI verification.

function.name: app_verify_ui
function.description: Take a screenshot and verify UI criteria using vision model. Returns PASS/FAIL with analysis.

criteria.description: What to verify (e.g., 'Navigation shows 6 links, page displays welcome message')

function.name: app_screenshot
function.description: Take a screenshot of the current page (for debugging). Returns base64 image data.

function.name: app_snapshot
function.description: Get accessibility tree snapshot of the page. Returns element UIDs for interaction.

function.name: app_navigate
function.description: Navigate to a URL or perform browser navigation (back, forward, reload).

url.description: URL to navigate to (required for type='url')

type.description: Navigation type: url, back, forward, reload (default: url)

function.name: app_click
function.description: Click an element by its UID (get UIDs from app_snapshot).

dblClick.description: Double-click instead of single click (default: false)

function.name: app_fill
function.description: Type text into an input field or select an option from a dropdown.

value.description: Text to enter or option to select

function.name: app_hover
function.description: Hover over an element (useful for dropdowns, tooltips).

function.name: app_press_key
function.description: Press a keyboard key or key combination (Enter, Tab, Ctrl+A, etc.).

function.name: app_wait_for
function.description: Wait for specific text to appear on the page.
